event_name: THRIVE-3 IV Choline Chloride interim results (2H 2026)
indication: Choline deficiency in adolescent and adult patients receiving long-term parenteral support
expected_disclosure: The first THRIVE-3 Phase 2b open-label dose-confirmation interim analysis is expected in the second half of 2026. The clinically relevant fields should include safety and tolerability, dose selection, plasma free-choline pharmacokinetics and change from baseline at week 8 across the planned 24-patient dose-confirmation stage.
uncertainties: The exact disclosure date, evaluable denominator and cutoff have not been announced.
The first analysis may emphasize pharmacokinetics, plasma choline and dose confirmation rather than longer-term hepatic outcomes.
